html:
The Mandandanji are an Aboriginal Australian people of southern inland Queensland, in the Maranoa and Balonne river country around today's Roma.

Their neighbours were the Gunggari to the west, the Bigambul to the south, and the Kongabula and Yiman to the north. Squatters moved into the Maranoa in the late 1840s, and the Mandandanji resisted them for years. The Native Police were sent to put down that resistance. Roma, founded in 1862, became the centre of the district.
sum: The Mandandanji are an Aboriginal Australian people of southern inland Queensland, in the Maranoa and Balonne river country around today's Roma.
